content: Foxline: Pi RPC brain owns per-model stream normalization (thinking/text separated into distinct content blocks). Gateway-side heuristic reasoning filters are legacy code to DELETE, not extend: blanket angle-tag stripping (strip_angle_tags_streaming/strip_angle_tags), sanitize_assistant_text tag replaces, strip_leading_reasoning_marker in crates/voice_gateway/src/brain.rs. The only residual text-channel compat is ThinkBlockFilter (think_block_filter.rs) for misconfigured endpoints that inject <think> tags into visible text. A new leak = Pi-side normalization bug caught by replay fixtures, never a reason to add another gateway filter layer. (Tommy, 2026-07-06)

Foxline: Rust Qwen3-TTS (e.g. qwen3_tts_rs_mario) ships ONLY if it matches the voice cloning quality (reference audio + text) of the current Python MLX worker (services/qwen3_tts_worker.py). Strategy: keep the TTS adapter trait modular so candidate backends (rust-mlx, rust-candle, cpp-ggml, Kokoro-class) are cheap to trial and A/B against the cloning baseline. End goal: drop Python from the runtime completely. Vision doc: docs/vision.md. (Tommy, 2026-07-06)
